review.images: Reviewed all six official gallery scenes and the wide hero. Removed the narrower duplicate fairway scene. The pool-side elevation supplies the card, with living and bedroom editorial images.
review.location: Matched the exact Golf Point point and regional Emaar South map. Verified the launch fact sheet’s four driving estimates visually and matched its refetched file to the cached SHA-256 0ea62a1e5ef96cc863981b894f3af2ce1bc86b76f70665d36642de05bf910ff2. The developer’s PDF is hosted by a third party and the official property page confirms the community.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed both original 37-page tower packs, including all 72 complete residence sheets. Cross-checked 85 total panels with PDFium, spatial extraction and arithmetic. Tower 2 physical page 3 prints 617.53 sq ft suite and 61.68 sq ft balcony with no total. The sheet and both component figures are available and no total is published for that layout.

unavailable: An official Tower 2 Type A.3 total, signed unit-specific areas and entrance coordinates were not verified.
